faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 is 19th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Treatment Supervisor and Laboratory Technician in the District Health Society Thanjavur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Treatment Supervisor post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Treatment Supervisor post, candidates need to possess a Bachelor's Degree OR a Recognized Sanitary Inspector's course, along with a Certificate course in Computer Operation (minimum 2 months) and a permanent two-wheeler driving license.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts advertised by DHS Thanjavur?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by the District Health Society Thanjavur is 65 years. Specific minimum age limits are not provided in the available data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026, as indicated in the official notification details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Laboratory Technician post in the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 will receive a salary of Rs. 17,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.answer: The application process for the DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.
